# Pixel Chess Clock

An offline, two-player chess clock. Each player starts with five minutes. Choose a side to begin; tap the other side after a move to switch turns. Use Pause to pause or resume and New game to reset both clocks. When a clock reaches zero, the display shows **Flag!** and the game stops.

## Run

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. The app uses only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; it needs no server, packages, or network connection.

## Controls

- Click, tap, or focus a player clock and press Enter or Space to start or switch turns.
- Activate Pause to pause or resume the active clock.
- Activate New game to reset both clocks.

The clock measures elapsed time from the system clock, so display refresh timing does not accumulate interval drift.
